honest.title: Key-free verifier for AI grant reviews on NEAR
honest.author: sieve-builder.redswarm-dhairya.testnet

reviews.reason: The proposal is specific, budgeted, and verifiable, but the three-week scope for one developer is not clearly feasible and the applicant has no track record.

A specific, well-scoped first grant with concrete verifiable deliverables, a matching 3-NEAR budget, and a stated benefit measure, failing only track_record since the applicant record shows no prior passed proposal or delivered milestone.

The proposal clearly defines a specific DAO verification problem, concrete open-source deliverables with public checkpoints, a small mapped budget, a named role, and a measurable benefit, while the applicant record shows no prior track record.

The evidence addresses the promised CLI verifier with a tag, commit hash, CI run, contract account and transaction hash, and states the gap openly, but the repository is private until 14 November 2026, so DAO members cannot clone it, inspect the commit or CI, or run the given verify command before voting.
Milestone 1 evidence is specific and on-chain, but the repository is private so DAO members cannot reproduce the check before voting, and the applicant record shows no earlier milestone delivery.

honest.evidence:
Milestone 1 delivered: the command-line verifier.

- Release: tag v0.1.0 of https://github.com/dhairya-pandya/sieve at commit 2204100e47ecab31ed98c75deac236b32d472291.
- Code: sieve/verify.py (the `sieve verify` command) with tests in tests/test_verify.py.
- CI: GitHub Actions run 42659078967, workflow "Tests"; the python and contract jobs passed on that commit.
- On chain: the verifier re-checked every review on contract sieve-v4.redswarm-dhairya.testnet and reported "23 reviews checked, 0 failed"; one checked review is transaction Hjo7FYFbH4Pro9CxcjZv6i7KAgHeNsXBMgx1LTffVpsn.
- How to check: git clone the repository, run `make setup`, then `.venv/bin/sieve verify`.

Gap, stated openly: the repository is private until the hackathon deadline and public by 14 November 2026.
